The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c032023361538707), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix positive upper exponents η+, b+. Consider a paired box as in Lemma 4.2, with integer coordinates satisfying |xi| ≪ Xη+/d , |yi| ≪ Xb+/d . Assume that its normalized chart variables have width O(X−w), that z = 1/n = O(X−1), and that the forward and reverse analytic chart functions have the uniform derivative bounds of that lemma. Let t∗, w > 0 be fixed rational numbers satisfying wd−1 H(t∗) >  (d + 1)(η+ + b+t∗) d2 d , wd−2 min{Ha(t∗), Hb(t∗)} >  η+ + b+t∗ d − 1 d−1 . (5.2) For sufficiently large X, the points in this box lie on a bounded number of bounded-degree algebraic sets of the following two types: 1. a mixed hypersurface section of V, whose bicone is a prime complete intersection with one additional equation of bidegree (λ, s0), where λ, s0 ≥ 1; 2. a set of biprojective dimension at most d − 2. On returning to the affine equations ak i bi = n − θi, the corresponding dimensions are d and at most d − 1. All number and degree bounds are uniform over the boxes and X.
